description: Source code for the PreloadedStateGenerator class, which generates transport security state data including Huffman encoding and pinset processing for Chromium's transport security features.

classes.name: PreloadedStateGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating preloaded transport security state data, including Huffman encoding and pinset processing.

methods.name: PreloadedStateGenerator::Generate
methods.description: Generates the transport security state data based on templates, entries, pinsets, and timestamp.

methods.name: PreloadedStateGenerator::ProcessSPKIHashes
methods.description: Processes SPKI hashes from pinsets and inserts them into the template.

methods.name: PreloadedStateGenerator::ProcessPinsets
methods.description: Processes pinsets, generating code for acceptable and rejected certs and report URIs, and updates the template.
